edge_types.meaning: A container includes an asset.
A composite asset, bundle, cluster, or workflow includes a member asset.
A workflow uses an asset as an ordered or named step.
A use/run/deployment instance instantiates one or more assets.
An asset explicitly references another.
An asset was derived from another.
A reviewed asset replaces an older asset.
Code or workflow implements a contract or design.
A document explains another asset.
A test evaluates another asset.
An asset requires another.
Assets have bounded semantic or structural similarity.
Assets are reviewed or candidate variants that share a core but may serve different contexts.
Assets provide non-identical capabilities that combine usefully.
A provider capability addresses a declared need.
A missing condition prevents activation.
A state change may make a dormant asset relevant.
A lesson is grounded in an event or asset.
Repeated lessons suggest a reusable skill.
An asset is constrained by a governance surface.

rule: Every generated edge must retain method, evidence, confidence, and scan provenance.
